name: zsnd_group_select_weighted_entry
description: zSndGroup::SelectWeightedEntry chooses a playable config block by weight and applies dynamic weight renormalization when enabled.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. The reconstruction remains limited because the exact compiler/source shape of the weighted random loop is still class-cluster audit debt.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja reconstruction for 0x4a4d10 validates single-entry guard behavior, skipping exhausted entries, weighted selection, dynamic selected-entry scaling, low-weight clamping, and 100-percent renormalization.
The native smoke verifies exhausted single-entry rejection, deterministic selection when only one entry remains playable, and dynamic renormalization of the selected entry.
